attacks.name: Claw Slash
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change one of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

attacks.name: Bloodthirsty Onslaught
steps: After this attack is resolved, Place this character within |!range| 1 of the defender.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change one of the defending character's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

superPowers.name: Catch, Runt!
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 2 and of |!size| 3 or less and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Primal Pounce
superPowers.body: Throw this character |!range_medium|. It does not suffer |!damage| if it collides with a character or terrain feature. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Stop Squealing and Die
superPowers.body: The next |*Claw Slash| or |*Bloodthirsty Onslaught| attack made by this character this Turn adds 3 dice to its attack roll.
